items.title: William "Big Bill" Thompson Interview, 1961-03-01
items.q: But the first one I ever heard played was Dave Dupass.

ctx.x: Do you remember who was the first one you ever heard play High Society, that clarinet part? Was it Pico or somebody else?
I heard Dave Dupass play on the clarinet. I heard Pico play that after, yeah. But the first one I ever heard played was Dave Dupass.
Do you remember George Bocquet clarinet player?
